subject: 10. New feature: save-listing (heart) on business detail + listing card
description: Add a save/heart button to the business detail / "More info" page (apps/web/src/app/(app)/listings/[category]/[id]/page.tsx). The user already has a "My Listings" area in their profile but no way to save a listing today. Decide: heart icon in the listing card AND on the detail page, or detail page only. Also requires backend (services + DB) — non-trivial; probably needs /mlabs-plan.
